key_expressions: How is your exam preparation going?,
Did you decide where to start studying?,
Should we review the important sections?,
Time management is the hardest part.,

A: Is your exam preparation going well?
Oh really? Then have you planned out your study schedule?
Nice! I can help check your plan if you want.
B: I’m studying little by little, but it's tougher than I thought.
Not completely, I just outlined the basics.
Really? That would be so helpful!

A: Did you decide where to start studying?
That order sounds good! It should help you understand better.
Yeah, focusing on key sections first is always smart.
B: Yes, I’m starting with the basic concepts.
After that, I’ll try solving some practice problems.
I think I should do that too!

A: Do you understand the concepts so far?
Right, if something feels unclear, it’s better to review it again.
Exactly! Let’s go over it once more before moving to exercises.
B: I understand about half, but some parts confuse me.
Yeah, so I’m trying to整理them again.
Alright, let’s do it now!

A: Did you try solving last year’s exam questions?
Oh wow, sounds like it was harder than expected!
Let’s solve some together—it's much easier that way.
B: Yes, but a few questions were really difficult.
Some of them didn’t make sense to me at all.
Really? Okay, let’s look at them now.

A: Is there any chapter you’re especially worried about?
Yeah, lots of people say that chapter is tough.
Let’s organize that section separately and review it again.
B: The chapter with the applied problems worries me the most.
Right, the explanations are quite complicated too.
Organizing it will help a lot!

A: Are you managing your study time well?
Yeah, that can be tricky to balance.
Try splitting your study time into shorter blocks—it really helps.
B: Not really. I always run out of time.
Everything takes longer than I expect.
Okay, I’ll try that method!

A: Are you memorizing the key points well?
Oh no, then want to try a different method?
Using images or associations might make it easier!
B: No, I keep forgetting them.
Even if I repeat them, they don’t stick.
I’ve never tried that—sounds interesting!

A: How far have you studied so far?
Oh, that’s actually really good progress!
Great! I can help with the remaining chapters.
B: I’ve studied about half of the material.
But the last chapters feel overwhelming.
I’d really appreciate your help!

A: Do you think you can finish today’s study goals?
Wow, you’re doing better than I thought!
Great, you’re almost done—just one last check!
B: Yes, I think I can finish if I work a bit more.
I’m actually going faster than expected.
Hearing that gives me more motivation!

A: Shall we review together one last time?
Oh, you seem much more confident now!
Nice! You’re almost fully prepared.
B: Sure! Let’s do it now.
Yeah, I think I’m finally getting the hang of it.
Thanks for your support—it really helps!
